policy.attempts: One attempt per cell, including failures and interrupted attempts; no silent reruns
policy.comparison: Both policies use the frozen V2 controller and shared movement optimizer. One fixed probe force is selected on all development tasks; the task-sufficient policy recomputes its target from each task load using the unchanged earlier method.
policy.success: SUCCESS requires the declared forward goal within 1 mm and simultaneous physical next-leg lift/certified support for the requested hold, in addition to every unchanged V2 criterion; stops/recovery never count as completion
policy.truth: Hidden pad strength is evaluator-only; sensing, geometry and error bounds are public
policy.interpretation: Predeclared engineering cases and declared seeds, not a statistical population or independent samples within each trace
policy.holdout: Held-out labels describe condition selection before evaluation; development conditions remain labeled separately
policy.damage: Pad damage is the actual failure latch, including successfully recovered damage; recovery never counts as movement completion
policy.avoidable_damage: A paired fixed-force pad failure is called avoidable here only when the task-sufficient policy completes the same movement undamaged
policy.selection: The scalar fixed force is selected before evaluation and cannot change with task, hidden capacity or seed
